protocol.search: Existing one-turn 8/3, unchanged weights; explicit single-world diagnostic.
protocol.roots: Fresh arrangements, seeds and frozen-V2 two-turn prefixes; never patch serialized battle state.
protocol.probe_actions: All eight search candidates plus deterministic legal command-category witnesses.
protocol.responses: All three native search replies, then frozen V2/category witnesses to six unique replies; fixed per root.
protocol.continuation: Frozen V2 from each side own public view, through one additional completed turn; six phase limit.
protocol.metrics: Terminal wins/losses, surviving allies/enemies, direct damaging actors; no route weights.
protocol.labels: Terminal outcomes are native facts conditional on supplied state/response/RNG. Other plan preferences unproven.
protocol.gates: Legal validated teams/actions; bounded complete phases; same replies/RNG across candidates; no result-based case removal.
limits: Designed categories do not guarantee a KO, trade or setup payoff exists.
Single exact hypothetical world bypasses admission; this is not a public-only player trial.
Four coupled RNG labels are scenarios, not probabilities.
Fixed previews, familiar species and sets, synthetic opposition; no competence claim.
These cases become development data after the first inspection.
